title: Two 25-Storey Condo Towers Proposed at Highway 7 and Kennedy in Markham
summary: Two 25-storey condominium towers are proposed to replace a single-storey commercial building and surface parking at the southeast corner of Highway 7 and Kennedy Road in Markham’s South Unionville neighbourhood. Designed by JET Design Architect for 2230583 Ontario Inc, 4691 Highway 7 would include ground-floor retail facing Kennedy Road.

title: Common Good
summary: Trees were still holding onto colour earlier this month at Corktown Common when a dog and their owner were caught enjoying a walk along the sweeping, raised boardwalk through the 13-year-old park. Nestled up against a berm that borders the Don River, the marsh below provides a wetland ecosystem of the type that used to follow this stretch of Lake Ontario shoreline before its industrialization during the 18- and 1900s.
